title: Leicester: the Touchline Take on the build-up
body:
BBC Sport has a build-up story involving Leicester [S1]. The headline said it plainly: “Wimborne to host Bradford in FA Cup second round - see the full draw” [S1]. The names in the frame: Wimborne Town and Dover Athletic [S1].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Leicester have 2 wins, 1 draw and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 7 points, 6 scored and 7 conceded [ST1].

Expect nerves early and a lot more freedom once the first goal goes in. Form matters, but big games have a habit of ignoring the spreadsheet. The Touchline Take: one to circle in the diary.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: Wimborne to host Bradford in FA Cup second round - see the full draw. Seventh-tier side Wimborne Town will host League One Bradford City in the second round of the FA Cup, while former winners Leicester City will visit National League South side Dover Athletic.
Leicester last 5 league matches in Football-Data.co.uk results: 2 wins, 1 draw, 2 defeats, 7 points, 6 goals scored, 7 conceded (sequence LWDWL).
